source: derived from 27A266a; test-runner and test-target rules measured on GitHub's xcode-27 runner (Xcode 27.2 27B52, iOS 27.2 runtime); xcode-run libs present and identical (same install names and sizes as 27.0's; each runtime build has its own sha256); ⌘R not driven
root: the simulator runtime root ($SIMULATOR_ROOT, else $DYLD_ROOT_PATH); paths below starting with / are relative to it
loader_reads: rules[].name and rules[].libs (ordered; each {path, if?, unless?}; a condition is VAR=value, PREFIX* (any variable with that prefix) or VAR (set)). Everything else is documentation. A missing rule or file falls back to the loader's built-in copy of this file
never_dlopened: libclang_rt.* (sanitizer runtimes) and libgmalloc.dylib, in every rule and the chain: they only work inserted at launch (ASan aborts with 'Interceptors are not working' when dlopened; a second TSan runtime gets mapped). Hard-coded in the loader, not read from here

rules.name: hosted-tests
rules.when: XCTestBundleInjectPath set and an XCTest marker present (XCInjectBundleInto, XCTestConfigurationFilePath, XCTestBundlePath or XCTestSessionIdentifier)
rules.load: exactly the XCTestBundleInjectPath list, de-duplicated; /usr/lib/... entries prefixed with the root; our own libraries and the never_dlopened ones skipped

xcodebuild_asan: + the three above (the app links its own runtime)
xcodebuild_tsan: + the three above (the app links its own runtime)

rules.without_rule: xcodebuild test hangs (test bundle never injected)

rules.name: ui-test-target
rules.when: XCODE_SCHEME_NAME set (app launched by XCUIApplication), no hosted-test rule

rules.name: test-runner
rules.when: read by the runner hook (libsimcamrunnerhook.dylib, engine/runnerhook/runnerhook.m), not the loader: `stuntcam exec -- xcodebuild test` on a launchd-armed or unarmed destination sets TEST_RUNNER_DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES=<hook>, which replaces the runner's own insert list (XCTestBundleInjectPath then reads /usr/lib/libRPAC.dylib:<hook>:<hook>); the hook dlopens these in its constructor
rules.paths: @testhost/<rel>: where dyld resolves XCTest's '<built products>/<App>.app/<rel>' entry: the leaf in DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH first (Xcode's iPhoneSimulator.platform/Developer/usr/lib copy), then the built and the installed host. /usr/... gets the runtime root. Launch-only libraries and already-mapped basenames are skipped

measured.with_TEST_RUNNER_DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES: /usr/lib/libRPAC.dylib:<hook>:<hook> (RPAC still loads; MTC and libXCTestBundleInject don't, and hosted tests hang without the latter)

rules.name: xcode-run
rules.when: an Xcode marker (MTC_*, PERFC_* or IDE_* variable, or DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH inside DerivedData), no rule above
rules.notes: each of these removes itself from DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES on load, so only libViewDebuggerSupport is visible in a plain run's env; MTC has no on/off signal (SIMCAM_MTC=0 skips it). Under ⌘R nothing in the app names the launching Xcode, so which file applies comes from the build recorded at arm time

unverified: the xcode-run rule under Xcode 27.2 ⌘R (not driven headless; its libs and Xcode's helper names checked statically only)
Detox / idb inserts (displaced: announced, not restored)
